The '''2027 Sunrisers Eastern Cape season''' is the fifth season of the franchise in the [[SA20]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BETWAY SA20 SEASON 5 FIXTURES ANNOUNCED |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-season-5-fixtures-announced |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The team is captained by [[Tristan Stubbs]] and coached by [[Adrian Birrell]].<ref>{{cite web |title=SA20 2027 to be held from January 17 to February 21|url=https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/139630/schedule-announcement-sa20-2027-to-be-held-from-january-17-to-february-21-cricbuzzcom |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=Cricbuzz}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=SA20 2027 starts January 17, final in Cape Town on February 21|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/sa20-2027-starts-january-17-final-in-cape-town-on-february-21-1547158 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=Cricinfo}}</ref>

==Background==
Following their third [[SA20]] title in the [[2026 SA20|2026 SA20 season]], Sunrisers Eastern Cape entered the 2027 season as the defending champions. During the off-season, the franchise retained [[Adrian Birrell]] as head coach while appointing [[Tristan Stubbs]] as captain following the departure of [[Aiden Markram]]. The core of the championship-winning squad was retained, with several domestic and overseas signings strengthening the team's roster ahead of the new campaign..<ref>{{cite web |access-date=25 January 2026 |title=SA20 Final 2026: Sunrisers Eastern Cape pips Pretoria Capitals to seal third title in four years |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/cricket/sa20-final-sunrisers-eastern-cape-vs-pretoria-capitals-third-title-stubbs-skipper-brevis-hundred-report/article70550742.ece |website=Sportstar}}</ref>

Ahead of the 2027 season, the league confirmed the tournament schedule, with Sunrisers Eastern Cape set to play their home matches at [[St George's Park Cricket Ground]] in [[Gqeberha]]. The franchise entered the season aiming to defend their title and become the first team in SA20 history to win four championships.

Retained players: [[Matthew Breetzke]], [[James Coles]] (England), [[Quinton de Kock]], [[Lewis Gregory]] (England), Jordan Hermann, [[Marco Jansen]] (Wildcard), CJ King - U23, JP King, Patrick Kruger, [[Adam Milne]] (New Zealand), Senuran Muthusamy, [[Anrich Nortje]], Lutho Sipamla, [[Tristan Stubbs]], [[Mitchell van Buuren]]

Pre-signings: [[Mitchell Marsh]] (Australia), [[Rishad Hossain]] (Bangladesh)

<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/140427/sa20-auction-pollard-rowles-headline-super-kings-buys|title=SA20 Auction: Pollard, Rowles headline Super Kings buys|access-date=7 October 2026|work=Cricbuzz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.clubcricket.co.za/latestnews/sa20-player-auction-updates/|title=SA20 player auction recap > who joined, where, for how much?|access-date=7 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref>
